info.title: Miletos Workflow Runtime API
info.description: Internal Go runtime API for synchronous and asynchronous workflow execution and execution observability.

503.description: One or more runtime dependencies are not ready

post.description: Executes a workflow locally and waits for a terminal domain result.
Durably accepts asynchronous workflow execution after persistence and initial outbox creation.
Creates an idempotent child execution that preserves successful source nodes and schedules only safe failed or timed-out recovery boundaries. The terminal source execution is never reopened.

202.description: Partial recovery accepted or replayed from the same idempotency key

bearerAuth.description: Internal service token supplied by the trusted control-plane caller. The credential is never embedded in this specification.

CompanyID.name: X-Miletos-Company-ID
CompanyID.description: Trusted tenant context supplied after internal service authentication. It is not end-user authorization.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Company-scoped idempotency key for asynchronous execution.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid internal service authentication

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not visible in the trusted company scope

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the configured limit
